contracts.declared_mechanism: Inline per-request guard chain in upload_file: empty-filename rejection (HTTP 400, lines 34-35); _sanitize_filename replacement of spaces and the characters \ / : * ? " < > | with underscores (line 38, implemented at lines 147-162); extension whitelist check against ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS raising HTTP 400 (lines 41-46); MAX_FILE_SIZE 10MB check on the read content raising HTTP 400 (lines 62-64). All checks execute upstream of the write commit at line 66.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A commit at file_path.write_bytes(content) where the composed filename retains path separators or characters '\', '/', ':', '*', '?', '"', '<', '>', '|' (i.e., was not passed through _sanitize_filename), or where the lowercased extension is not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS ['txt', 'md'], or where len(content) > MAX_FILE_SIZE (10 * 1024 * 1024 bytes).

contracts.protected_operation: Persistence of an uploaded file's bytes to the ./uploads directory via the upload_file handler of the POST /upload route.
contracts.protected_resource: Filesystem paths under UPLOAD_DIR = Path("./uploads") written by the upload handler.
contracts.protection_obligation: The POST /api/upload handler must refuse to persist user-supplied upload bytes to disk unless the filename has been sanitized of path separators and illegal characters (preventing writes outside ./uploads), the extension is whitelisted to {txt, md}, and the content is at most 10MB; disk persistence may occur only after all three guards pass, at file_path.write_bytes(content). (Merges the phase-one and phase-two reviewer wordings, which declare the same guard set and commit point.)
scope_limits: Covers only the write_bytes commit point at app/api/file.py:66; the overwrite deletion file_path.unlink() (lines 55-57) executes after sanitization and extension checks but before the size check, so the 10MB guard does not gate that unlink effect.
Does not cover the POST /index_directory endpoint (lines 100-128), which passes a caller-supplied directory_path to vector_index_service.index_directory with no guard declared in the supplied source.
The upload directory is fixed to UPLOAD_DIR = Path("./uploads") (line 14); writes to any other filesystem sink are outside this contract.
The vector-index side effect (line 73) is non-blocking on upload success (lines 75-77) and is not part of this contract.
Guards are evaluated inline per request; no claim is made about concurrent-write races or TOCTOU between check and commit.
Ordinary HTTP handling (status codes, router mechanics) is context only; no web-authentication or CORS obligation is asserted.
